label: Absolute country control
summary: Turns absolute country control on or off for the character.
details: The game's documentation line also mentions `unlock_character_movement`, which does not match the key, so what exactly the flag changes is not documented. Vanilla mostly sets it to `yes` (3 times) and once to `no`. It also accepts a boolean saved target.

label: Accolade successor
summary: Sets the successor of the accolade to the given character.
details: Works on an accolade. The value is a character, for example a saved scope. Vanilla uses it once, with a saved chosen knight.

label: Activity host
summary: Makes the given character the host of the activity.
details: Works on an activity. The value is a character. Vanilla uses it once, with a saved new host.

label: Activity intent
summary: Sets the character's intent (their personal goal) for the activity they are currently in.
details: It fails with an error if the activity does not support that intent or the character is not eligible for it. It can be written as just the intent name, or as a block with `intent` and an optional `target` character. Vanilla uses it for the exam taker intents.

fields.name: target
fields.text: A character given along with the intent. The game's documentation shows it only in the block form and says nothing more about it.

label: Age
summary: Sets the character's age.
details: This skips birthday on-actions, age-related health changes and the like, just like the console command. The value is a script value; vanilla once gives a range of two numbers (35 to 60).

label: Allow early retreat
summary: Lets one side of a battle retreat even if the battle was short, should it lose.
details: Without it, a side cannot retreat manually before the battle has lasted a minimum number of days. `no` undoes it and is the default. Works on a combat side. Vanilla does not use it in the input given.

label: Always follows primary heir
summary: Sets whether the title always goes to the primary heir in partition succession.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla only uses `yes`.

label: Amenity level
summary: Sets the level of one court amenity for the character.
details: Vanilla uses it for court amenities such as fashion, lodging standards, food quality and servants, with levels from 2 to 5, either as a number or as a script value such as `high_amenity_level`.

fields.name: type
fields.values: an amenity type, for example court_fashion, court_lodging_standards, court_food_quality, court_servants

fields.name: value
fields.text: The level to set it to.
fields.values: a number or a script value

label: Appointment timeout
summary: Sets a timeout during which the character does not take part in any appointment.
details: An existing longer timeout is not overridden. The time is given in `days`, `months` or `years` (vanilla uses years). An optional `desc` gives a localization key for the reason.

fields.name: desc
fields.text: The localization key of the reason for the timeout.

label: Location
summary: Moves the army straight to the given province.
details: It cannot be done while the army is in combat. If hostile units are in the target province, a battle starts with this army as the attacker.

label: Description
summary: Sets the description text of the artifact.
details: The value is a dynamic description: in vanilla mostly a plain localization key, sometimes a saved scope.

label: Feature
summary: Gives the artifact one specific feature.
details: If the artifact already has a feature of the same group, the new one replaces it. The value is a feature key.

label: Feature group
summary: Gives the artifact a feature picked from the given feature group.
details: The pick uses the current scopes and the weights the group defines. If the artifact already has a feature of that group, it is replaced. Vanilla uses groups such as head_decoration or book_subject.

label: Name
summary: Sets the name of the artifact.
details: The value is a dynamic name: in vanilla almost always a localization key, once a saved scope.

label: Rarity
summary: Sets the rarity of the artifact.
details: Its graphics and similar things are not updated by this. Vanilla uses common, famed, masterwork and illustrious.

label: Beneficiary
summary: Makes the given character the beneficiary of the character.
details: The character it runs on is the one who gets a beneficiary; the target is the one who becomes it. Vanilla uses it once, with a saved character.

label: Bonus fascination
summary: Marks an innovation as the culture's bonus fascination, which gives the culture extra progress rate on it.
details: The size of the bonus is set in the game's defines file (INNOVATION_PROGRESS_GAIN_FROM_BONUS_FASCINATION). The bonus ends when the innovation is discovered, when this effect is used again on the culture, or when it is reset with `reset_bonus_fascination_innovation`. The innovation can be written as its key or as a saved scope. Works on a culture.

label: Called to war
summary: Marks the given character as already called into the war.
details: Works on a war. The value is a character. Vanilla uses it with saved characters or the root character.

label: Named after dynasty
summary: Sets whether the title can take its name from its holder's dynasty.
details: The game's documentation example writes the key with an extra `_effect` suffix, which looks like a typo. Vanilla uses it with `no` more often than `yes`. Works on a title.

label: Convertible to
summary: Sets whether characters can convert to this rite.
details: `yes` allows it, `no` forbids it. Works on a rite.

label: Nomadic naming
summary: Sets whether the title can use the dynamic naming meant for nomads.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla only uses `no`.

label: Capital barony
summary: Makes this barony the capital of its county.
details: Works on a barony title, written `= yes`.

label: Capital county
summary: Sets the capital county of the title to the given county.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla uses it often, usually with another title's capital county.

label: Casus belli
summary: Sets the casus belli (the war's justification) of the war.
details: Works on a war. Vanilla uses it twice, both times with `depose_war`. The game's documentation says nothing more about it.

label: Faith
summary: Changes the character's faith and runs the effects of the change.
details: For setting up history files, use `set_character_faith_history` instead. Vanilla uses it a lot, with faiths from keys or saved scopes.

label: Faith (history)
summary: Changes the character's faith without running the effects of the change.
details: Meant only for history setup.

label: Faith (with conversion)
summary: Changes the character's faith as if they used the faith-view interaction, without the piety cost.
details: Vassals who would accept the new faith are converted too, and so are capitals.

label: Rite
summary: Changes the character's rite and runs the effects of the change.
details: For setting up history files, use `set_character_rite_history` instead. Vanilla uses it a lot, with rites from keys or saved scopes.

label: Rite (history)
summary: Changes the character's rite without running the effects of the change.
details: Meant only for history setup. Vanilla does not use it in the input given.

label: Rite (with conversion)
summary: Converts the character to the given rite, if they can, and then fires the on_faith_conversion on-action.
details: Vassals only convert if the target character's faith changed.

label: Secret faith
summary: Changes the character's secret faith.
details: The value is a faith, for example `faith:rabbinism`.

label: Child of concubine
summary: Sets whether the child of a pregnancy will be a child of a concubine.
details: Works on the pregnant character. The game's documentation gives no usage line, so the accepted values are not shown; its wording ("to be or not be") suggests a yes/no value.

label: Coat of arms
summary: Gives a title, dynasty, house, organization or confederation the coat of arms of the given thing of the same type.
details: The value is either a title key such as `k_england` or a saved scope of the same type. Vanilla uses it a lot, mostly with keys.

label: Cohesion
summary: Sets the confederation's cohesion to the given amount.
details: The game's documentation gives no usage line or range, so the accepted values are not documented.

label: Color from title
summary: Gives the title the map color of the given title, shifted very slightly so they are not identical.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla uses it often with an old title or a capital county.

label: Color
summary: Changes the map color of the confederation (or bloc).
details: Both a named color and three RGB numbers such as `{ 255 128 64 }` work.

label: Name
summary: Sets the name of the confederation.
details: The value is a dynamic description (a localization key). Vanilla uses it once, with the key CONFEDERATION_HOUSE_NAME.

label: Council task
summary: Sets the task of the councillor.
details: Works on the character who is the councillor. A task that needs a target takes it in `target`. Vanilla uses it for tasks such as finding secrets or conversion.

fields.name: task_type
fields.values: a council task key, for example task_find_secrets

fields.name: target
fields.text: What the task is aimed at, for tasks that need one.
fields.values: for example a province or a saved scope

label: Culture (county)
summary: Changes the culture of the county.
details: Works on a county title. The value is a culture, for example `culture:english` or a saved culture.

label: Faith (county)
summary: Changes the faith of the county.
details: Works on a county title. The value is a faith, from a key or a saved scope.
